lesson_intent.one_sentence_goal: Practice keeping small talk alive with short reactions and follow-up questions.
lesson_intent.real_life_context: A colleague shares a small weekend or evening update during lunch.
lesson_intent.communicative_function: Showing interest and encouraging the conversation to continue.

dialogue_task.scenario: Anna and Erik talk over lunch after one of them mentions a small personal update from the previous evening.

main_focus.name: short reaction plus follow-up question
main_focus.description: Combine a natural reaction phrase with a simple question that asks for one more detail.
main_focus.desired_presence: Use a reaction plus follow-up question naturally 3-4 times in the dialogue.

vocabulary_target.desired_presence: Use reaction chunks repeatedly, with varied but simple follow-up questions.

dialogue_shape.opening: One person shares a small everyday update.
dialogue_shape.middle: The other person reacts and asks for one more detail two or three times.
dialogue_shape.ending: They summarize the feeling or outcome of the update.

target_complexity.repetition: repeat reaction patterns with slight variation

focus: the emotional reaction to the update
the outcome or final detail of the story

sentence_focus: one sentence asking what happened next
one sentence asking how something was
one sentence combining a reaction and a follow-up question
